_comment: LLM judge for gb-2019-full-investigation with per-topic request scoping (decision 52). The API key is never in this file: export OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Pass this file with --config together with the full-investigation answer key and bundle.
_temperature: sent only where the model lists it on OpenRouter (openai/gpt-6.1-sol does not: it is a reasoning model); the run records temperature_sent per request
_prices: used only when OpenRouter reports no cost for a request (decision 25: about $2 / $10 per million tokens)
_modes: auto_numeric criteria are never sent; auto_assisted_human proposals are recorded for the reviewer and ignored by the merge
_rubric_file: a path with a directory is read under environment/incident/private/
_scope: each topic's request carries only its own findings in full, the report text that refers to them, their cited spans and its keyed spans, plus every other finding by ID, status and opening words (judge/scope.py). T17 (the uncertainty register) is cross-cutting: it sees every finding and the whole report, and the cited spans of its own findings. error_screen: a topic whose judge criteria an error stated anywhere bounds (contradiction rules, severe flags) also shows every finding with a sentence that meets those patterns or whose sentence vocabulary ranks the topic.
